scope: Independent review of transport_faults.py and its directly used helpers (setup, Service, open_upload, no_attachment, Evidence, PostgreSQL lifecycle); not the entire inherited fault corpus.
reviewer: /root/b21_service, not author of the transport controller

findings.finding: The H2 hold stops reading, which can conceal pre-credit DATA queued by a noncompliant peer until after local receive credit is restored. Pump and validate frames without acknowledging DATA during the hold, reject excess/reset/END_STREAM, and record held bytes.
The exact-response assertion currently checks only HTTP200 and nonempty operationId. Bind the actual v1 attachment DTO and SQL-stored response bytes to that returned operation identity.

An outer post-case exception or between-case interruption can leave Evidence.close reporting passed over only completed cases. Require all three named cases, unchanged artifacts, and no top-level failure before final status passes.

other_observations: 64KiB initial body positively reaches a real partial staging file before barriers.
Independent SQL excludes premature attachment reference and item-version increment.
SIGTERM occurs with incomplete client connection still held open; process exit0 and CLOSED resource joins are separately required.
Actual TLS trust and h2 ALPN precede the download; complete bytes, length, hash and END_STREAM are required after resuming.
Procfs samples have no aggregate-root/native-owner claim; long-duration/performance/fullB22 acceptance explicitly remain false.
